hero.title: Paw-ism
hero.subtitle: You're a cat sneaking around, avoiding the cleaning lady while collecting mice. Made in 48 hours for Unwrap Jam 2025.

story.title: Game Mechanics
story.subtitle: Gather mice, navigate the roomba, and complete objectives before getting caught.

f1.title: Collect Mice
f1.desc: Gather mice from wall crevices while staying alert to the cleaning lady's whereabouts.

f2.title: Use the Roomba
f2.desc: Ride the robotic vacuum to move swiftly through the environment and gain tactical advantages.

f3.title: Execute Your Plan
f3.desc: Complete your objective before time runs out.

role.title: Sound Design
role.subtitle: Did all the audio for this 48-hour jam.

f1.title: Ambient Atmosphere
f1.desc: Built looping ambient layers for the house environment.

f2.title: Interactive SFX
f2.desc: Cat footsteps, item pickups, getting spotted—all the gameplay sounds.

f3.title: Audio Implementation
f3.desc: Hooked everything up in Unreal so sounds trigger when stuff happens.

team.title: Team
team.subtitle: 7-person team of developers, artists, and sound designers. 48-hour development cycle.
